description: Synthetic, made up for a test. Request 0 to 99. The pinned genesis is the FLOP devnet genesis (DEVNET_GENESIS in src/status.ts); every event and block hash is made up. Clause numbers refer to RULES.md section 3.1. The page files are written by hand. Two files hold page 0 for blocks 0 to 99. The first is standard JSON and holds a release. The second, 01-nan-index.json, holds an event with index NaN. NaN is not standard JSON (RFC 8259), so that file cannot be parsed as JSON and the whole census refuses (clause 12), even though a lenient parser would read it. Expected: the census refuses; no totals.
